_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-standalone mindustry/egg-mindustry.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail changes the install script (the release from the GitHub API over HTTPS, its SHA-256 digest checked, a missing release or asset fails the install, no unused GitHub login) and adds the mindustry tag, Java 21 and Java 17 images (upstream: Java 11, too old for current releases), the startup commands as one quoted argument (Mindustry splits them at commas, so the name can't hold commas, double quotes or backslashes), map names as one word (_ for spaces, as Mindustry matches them), a game mode and an optional save slot to load instead of a new map, a version rule (latest or a vNNN tag), generic TCP idle sleep (off until staff enable it per server), the say broadcast, install sandbox defaults and resource hints.
name: Mindustry
author: sir3lit@gmail.com
description: Mindustry is a hybrid tower-defense sandbox factory game. Create elaborate supply chains of conveyor belts to feed ammo into your turrets, produce materials to use for building, and defend your structures from waves of enemies.
startup: java -Xms128M -Xmx{{SERVER_MEMORY}}M -jar server-release.jar "config port {{SERVER_PORT}},config name {{SERVER_NAME}},$( [ -n "${LOAD_SLOT}" ] && printf 'load %s' "${LOAD_SLOT}" || printf 'host %s %s' "${MAPNAME}" "${GAMEMODE}" )"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Mindustry installation script (pelican-eggs, changed for Octail: the release from the GitHub API over HTTPS, its
# SHA-256 checked, failures exit non-zero)
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl jq ca-certificates > /dev/null

VERSION="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
    API="https://api.github.com/repos/Anuken/Mindustry/releases/latest"
else
    API="https://api.github.com/repos/Anuken/Mindustry/releases/tags/${VERSION}"
fi
if ! RELEASE=$(curl -fsSL "$API"); then
    echo "Installation failed: Mindustry release ${VERSION} wasn't found on GitHub."
    exit 1
fi
TAG=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r '.tag_name')
URL=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name == "server-release.jar") | .browser_download_url')
DIGEST=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name == "server-release.jar") | .digest // empty')
if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: release ${TAG} has no server-release.jar."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installing Mindustry ${TAG} from ${URL}"
cd /mnt/server
curl -fsSL -o server-release.jar.new "$URL"
if [ -n "$DIGEST" ]; then
    if ! echo "${DIGEST#sha256:}  server-release.jar.new" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
        rm -f server-release.jar.new
        echo "Installation failed: the download doesn't match its checksum."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "GitHub lists no checksum for this release; not checked."
fi
mv -f server-release.jar.new server-release.jar

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: Mindustry ${TAG}."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The release to install: latest, or a GitHub tag such as v146. Reinstall to switch.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The server name in the server list (up to 64 characters; no commas, double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: Map Name
variables.description: The map hosted at start, with _ for spaces: Ancient_Caldera, Archipelago, Debris_Field, Domain, Fork, Fortress, Glacier, Islands, Labyrinth, Maze, Molten_Lake, Mud_Flats, Passage, Shattered, Tendrils, Triad, Veins, Wasteland, or a custom map in config/maps.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: The mode the map is hosted in: survival, sandbox, attack or pvp.

variables.name: Load Save Slot
variables.description: Optional: a save slot (from save <slot> in the console) loaded at start instead of hosting a new map. Empty = a new game on the map above.
